question: why can the planner not cross Pallet Town?

per_action.note: model's predicted tile vs the real one, from the same state

finding: Predicted x is ~7.2 for every action while the truth is 5, and varies only 6.8-7.5 across all seven. Adjacent BFS levels differ by one tile; the probe's error in Pallet Town is 1.44-1.88 tiles. The signal the planner needs is below the noise floor of the instrument reading it. Map classification is fine -- `up` is correctly predicted to enter map 37.
ruled_out: horizon: 14 vs 30 made no difference (0/3 either way)
action repeats: 1, 2 and 4 made no difference (0/3)
the dynamics model: one-step prediction beats no-change by 44x-631x
next: Raw downsampled pixels probe Pallet position better than the encoder (R^2 0.912/0.803 vs 0.760/0.655), so more signal exists than a linear readout extracts. A non-linear head, or more Pallet data (3,233 of 31,759 frames; the bedroom is 76%), are the cheap tests.
